content.short: Bundle Fren enables token deployment, bundling and launching with no coding or experience.
content.description: Bundle Fren provides a secure, sniper-free platform for token launches, putting creators in control of every step of the drop. Tokens can be deployed, bundled, and launched in under two minutes with no coding required and no intermediaries. The platform gives users full control over their launch and enables them to be the first to buy their own token, while managing multiple wallets seamlessly from a single dashboard and coordinating multi-wallet activity across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Solana, Base, Sui, and other supported chains.
content.meta: Bundle Fren lets you deploy, bundle and launch tokens with no coding or experience. Discover Bundle Fren and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What Is Bundling in Crypto?
resources.tldr: Grouping several transactions into one atomic execution so they either all land in order or none do. Explains why ordering guarantees matter far more than the gas saving.
